title: The finite-injury strategy selects a witness already in the set it later tries to change.
details: Marks, dated 2024-02-25, Theorem 24.1 proof, printed p. 88 (PDF88), first paragraph of the R_e strategy. Visually checked: it chooses a witness n inB, then proposes later enumerating n intoB when the oracle computation returns0; in the alternative case the verification says n will never be enumerated. These instructions conflict. The witness must instead be fresh and outside the currentB, distinct from other active witnesses and respecting all higher-priority restraints. Keep it out unless the diagonal action enumerates it. This repairs the local sign slip, but a full effective-stage and injury audit remains required before the planned priority entry. No current consumer.
